name: Wickede (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of blue, white and blue with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Wickede (Ruhr) (a black cross on white above a blue wavy base).
history: Municipal flag of Wickede; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wickede arms — cross above wavy base
